title: Review Finding Budget
fixture_requirements: Seven independently reachable blockers across concern axes: proration boundary (B1), injection (B2), non-atomic delete (B3), money-order inconsistency (B4), seat race (B5), naive date parse (B6), null-owner crash (B7).
Exact-duplicate pair: B7 reachable from invoiceEmail and renewalNotice (same root, consequence, fix).
Shared-root pair: B6 naive parse drives two consequences (expiry decision, displayed date).
Two should-fix (SF1 no teams tests, SF2 swallowed gateway error) and one nit (N1 inline name-length literal).
Branch adds no test files; the suite passes so every defect survives only through review discovery.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-dir> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
